cards.back: The site boundary can include paths, tanks, packing and support equipment; the production boundary contains only declared growing zones. Excluding a flow from either boundary does not make it disappear.
A stock is present at a stated time; a flow crosses the boundary during an interval. Closing stock = opening stock + inputs − outputs ± explained adjustments.
A named decision requiring a responsible reviewer and evidence, such as local land-use, safety or environmental review. Arithmetic cannot mark the gate complete.
For constant PPFD, DLI = PPFD × hours × 3600/10⁶. PPFD is an instantaneous photon flux density; DLI is the daily time integral.
Take the union of verified on-intervals, not the sum of schedule labels. Commands also need an independent actual on/off or power check.
Energy (kWh) = fixture count × power per fixture (kW) × verified operating time (h). It is not photon output or proof of plant response.
Closing stock = opening stock + new input + recovered water − consumption − other declared outputs. Closure does not establish water quality.
Record missing as missing. Zero, a carried-forward number and a measured value are different claims; imputation must be labelled.
A setpoint states intent and a command requests action; actuator feedback and environmental observations are needed to establish response.
Molecular outcome, phenotype, agronomic performance and whole-system effect are distinct claims requiring distinct evidence; success at one level does not prove the next.
A comparator helps test handling, background variation and assay alternatives. It does not replace independent lineages or genome-wide specificity assessment.
Cite Zong 2017 with its 2025 correction; cite Jin 2019 separately for unintended-variant context. Neither secondary slogans nor system benefits substitute for the records.
Trace demand through members and supports to the foundation/ground boundary, with assumptions and unresolved capacity questions. It is not a construction design.
A successor waits for all required predecessors. For parallel 3-day and 4-day tasks before a 2-day review, finish = max(3, 4) + 2 = 6 days.
Record a concept change and re-evaluate affected load paths, work items, dependencies and human reviews; earlier approval does not automatically cover the revision.
Power is instantaneous kW; energy is power integrated over time in kWh. Outage arithmetic also needs duration, critical loads, losses and reserves.
A residual flags a missing flow, metering disagreement or arithmetic problem. Do not erase it with an unexplained balancing category.
Recovered volume divided by recovered plus new input is an accounting ratio only. It establishes neither quality, reliability nor life-support performance.
Energy residual = supplies − declared loads; water residual = start + inputs − consumed − end. Recompute every row and preserve the sign.
The field is an evidence gap, not zero, favourable conditions or proof of an excursion. Keep it unavailable to temperature conclusions.
A01/A06 agreement is descriptive only. Shared templates and assumptions do not create independent replication or a real-world reliability interval.
Boundary → light/water → biological evidence and structural work logic → outage/audit → bounded handoff. Preserve links and human gates at each step.
The project must link Zong with its 2025 correction and Jin as a separate study; a citation list is incomplete if it omits the correction.
Include synthetic provenance, assumptions, residuals, evidence gaps and unresolved human decisions. Rehearsal arithmetic never authorizes construction or habitat operation.
